massgrant.title: MASSGrant
massgrant.description: Need-based grant for Massachusetts residents attending college in-state.
checklist: Check award notification from your school

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Complete the FAFSA and review your financial aid notice from your Massachusetts institution.

faq.question: Who may qualify?
faq.answer: Massachusetts residents attending college in-state with financial need may qualify.

faq.question: What documents do I need?
faq.answer: You typically need FAFSA-related financial information and school enrollment records.
